newsitem.title: CANADA: Northstar to buy back 23.5 pct of shares.
newsitem.headline: Northstar to buy back 23.5 pct of shares.

text.p: Northstar Energy Corp said on Wednesday it would buy 20.69 million, or 23.5 percent, of its shares at C$14.50 each in its offer buy back stock in a Dutch auction.
Northstar said a preliminary count by trustees indicated that 63.20 million shares were deposited at C$14.50 each, which meant they would be subject to a proration factor of 33 percent.
The deal, announced with Northstar's acquisition of Morrison Petroleums Ltd earlier this year, is valued at about C$300 million.
Northstar said payment for the shares would be made early in the week of April 2 and the company planned to return shares not purchased as soon as possible.
After the purchase, Northstar would have 67.5 million shares outstanding.
The buyback was expected to be accretive to both earnings and cash flow per share, Northstar said.
